confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors use Warsaw city-level prices last updated 15 October 2026; the cocktail estimate is a 47 PLN average from seven price points updated 3 September 2026. A glass of wine is inferred at about 1.4 times a local draft beer because reliable direct glass pricing was not available. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates and vary with season and events.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are estimated directly from Warsaw price data; accommodation reflects a large Central European capital.
